raw_requirement_retained: The RAW already requires exact independently corresponding C whole forms on unseen families. This review does not present that existing demand as a new invention.

automatic_agreement_counterexample.construction: Choose arbitrary bijections e_A,e_B,e_C from each hand vocabulary to a common index set. Define T_AB=inverse(e_B) o e_A, T_BC=inverse(e_C) o e_B and T_AC=inverse(e_C) o e_A.
automatic_agreement_counterexample.identity: T_BC o T_AB = inverse(e_C) o e_B o inverse(e_B) o e_A = T_AC.
automatic_agreement_counterexample.consequence: Every path agrees even if common indices pair unrelated words. Agreement alone cannot assess correspondence; an independently observed C target can still reject both predictions.

information_loss_counterexample.consequence: No deterministic word-only B-to-C map recovers both distinct C forms. A shared content system may nevertheless use homography plus context. This rejects only the underspecified word-local recoverability condition, not shared language.
information_loss_counterexample.qualification: Two routes can also agree after shared information loss. A closed A-to-B-to-C-to-A identity would require injectivity on the checked A inputs; simple two-path equality alone does not.

required_separate_outputs: Was the independent observed C form predicted exactly by direct transport?
Was it predicted exactly by transport through B?
Did the two predictions agree? Both may agree and be wrong; agreement is not a second independent semantic confirmation.
correspondence_requirements: Do not derive the held C partner from the tested transform, common frequency rank, nearest spelling, or matching optimized on target outputs.
Declare allography/homography and contextual information before fitting; raw-string identity is not implied by common content alone.
A/B/C must denote actual scribal hands, not ZL/IT/RF readings of the same ink.
Retain the RAW whole-family/physical-leaf split, independently fit the direct path and charge matched model budgets.
No confirmed translation is required to pose a structural correspondence test, but the correspondence must have evidence independent of the evaluated mapping.
